attributes.title: 2027 ACOG Annual Clinical & Scientific Meeting
attributes.organizer: American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists
attributes.summary:
ACOG's 2027 Annual Clinical & Scientific Meeting (ACSM) takes place May 21 to 23, 2027, in Los Angeles, California. The meeting offers focused programming for clinicians who provide obstetric and gynecologic care.

Registration is open, and on-site registration is at the Los Angeles Convention Center. ACOG Fellows pay $750 at the Early Access rate through January 29, 2027, $850 at the Advance rate through May 14 and $950 on site. Non-ACOG physicians and other health care professionals pay $950, $1,050 or $1,150, Junior Fellows in Training $525, $625 or $750, and ACOG medical student members $150, $200 or $250. Member rates require membership valid through May 23, 2027. The CME statement was not on the pages we checked. Sessions from the 2026 meeting can be bought as ACSM On Demand.
